Ambusher.name: Ambusher
Ambusher.description: In tu companion's natural environment, it can use a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} action even if it's currently observed. Its proficiency rank in Stealth increases to experto (or maestro if it was already an experto from its type), and its Dexterity modifier increases by 1. Its proficiency rank for unarmored defense increases to experto.

Auspice.name: Auspice
Auspice.description:
A faithful steed with the auspice specialization gains the following benefits.

  • It gains the celestial, fiend, or monitor rasgo—whichever best matches tu deity's servitors, and its appearance shifts to look more like those servitors. It also gains the holy rasgo if it's a celestial or the unholy rasgo if it's a fiend.
  • Its Intelligence modifier increases by 2 and its Wisdom modifier by 1.
  • Its proficiency rank in Religion increases to experto.
  • It can speak the language associated with tu deity's servitors (such as Empyrean for celestials, Chthonian for demons, or Requian for psychopomps).
  • Its maximum Puntos de Golpe increase by 20, increasing to 25 at 18th level and 30 at 20th level. If the mount has the celestial rasgo, the extra HP increase by 5, and the mount gains weakness 5 to unholy. If it has the fiend rasgo, the extra HP increase by 5, and the mount gains weakness 5 to holy.
  • It gains wings that grant it a fly Velocidad equal to its land Velocidad.

0.prompt: Select a specialized companion tienes access to

Auspicious Mount.name: Montura Propicia
Auspicious Mount.description:
Guided by tu ongoing care, tu steed has developed incredible intelligence and skill. The mount tú gained with Faithful Steed is now a specialized animal companion. Puedes select one of the usual specializations or the auspice specialization. A faithful steed with the auspice specialization gains the following benefits.

  • It gains the celestial, fiend, or monitor rasgo—whichever best matches tu deity's servitors, and its appearance shifts to look more like those servitors. It also gains the holy rasgo if it's a celestial or the unholy rasgo if it's a fiend.
  • Its Intelligence modifier increases by 2 and its Wisdom modifier by 1.
  • Its proficiency rank in Religion increases to experto.
  • It can speak the language associated with tu deity's servitors (such as Empyrean for celestials, Chthonian for demons, or Requian for psychopomps).
  • Its maximum Puntos de Golpe increase by 20, increasing to 25 at 18th level and 30 at 20th level. If the mount has the celestial rasgo, the extra HP increase by 5, and the mount gains weakness 5 to unholy. If it has the fiend rasgo, the extra HP increase by 5, and the mount gains weakness 5 to holy.
  • It gains wings that grant it a fly Velocidad equal to its land Velocidad.

Billowing Wings.name: Alas ondeantes
Billowing Wings.description:
Has entrenado tu winged companions to gather air in their wings, whipping up a concentrated gust of wind at opponents, potentially staggering them.

Tu companions with wings gain a gust ranged ataque sin armas, which deals 1d4 daño contundente with a range of 30 pies and has the air and propulsive rasgos. On a impacto crítico, el objetivo is pushed back 5 pies. Este is forced movement.

1.text: On a impacto crítico, el objetivo is pushed back 5 pies. Este is forced movement.

Bully.name: Bully
Bully.description: Tu companion terrorizes foes with dominance displays and pushes them around the battlefield. Its proficiency ranks for Athletics and Intimidation increase to experto (or maestro if it was already experto from its type), its Strength modifier increases by 1, and its Charisma modifier increases by 3.

Daredevil.name: Daredevil
Daredevil.description: Tu companion joins the fray with graceful leaps and dives. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.PNpmVmD21zViDtGC]{deny advantage} ability, so it isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}, or flanking criaturas unless such a criatura's level is greater than yours. Its proficiency rank in Acrobatics increases to maestro, and its Dexterity modifier increases by 1. Its proficiency rank in unarmored defense increases to experto.

Deep Diver.name: Deep Diver
Deep Diver.description: Tu companion gains a swim Velocidad of 30 pies or a +10-pies bonificador de estado to its existing swim Velocidad and can breathe underwater if it couldn't already. Its Constitution modifier increases by 1. Its proficiency rank for Athletics increases to maestro and for barding increases to experto. Este specialization can only be selected by marid-touched companions.

Faithful Steed.name: Corcel fiel
Faithful Steed.description: Tu mount gains the holy or unholy rasgo, as do the mount's Golpes.

Ferocious Charge.name: Carga feroz
Ferocious Charge.description: The companion Strides up to twice its Velocidad in a straight line and makes an antlers, head, or horn Golpe. If it moved at least 20 pies, it deals an additional 1d8 daño. Este daño increases to 2d8 if tu companion is specialized. The companion can use Ferocious Charge while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if it has the corresponding movement type.

Genie-Touched Companion.name: Genie-Touched Companion
Genie-Touched Companion.description:
If sufres a feat that would normally allow tú to elige to have a savage or nimble animal companion, puedes instead elige to for it to become a genie-touched companion. When tú elige the feat, select the type of genie whose power infuses tu companion. The genies and their elemental rasgos are as follows: djinni (air), efreeti (fire), marid (water), or shaitan (earth). A genie-touched companion increases its Wisdom modifier by 2 and its Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution modifiers by 1. It deals 3 daño adicional with its ataques sin armas; this daño is daño de fuego for an efreet-touched companion or of the same type as the ataque sin armas for the others. It gains resistance 5 to daño of a type depending on the genie: acid for djinni, fire for efreeti or marid, and electricity for shaitan. If the companion is djinni-touched or efreeti-touched, increase its proficiency rank in Acrobatics to experto; if it is marid-touched or shaitan-touched, increase its proficiency rank in Athletics to experto. It also learns the advanced maneuver for its type. Its attacks count as magical for the purpose of ignoring resistances and gain the genie's elemental rasgo.

Genie-touched companions can elige from the following options when they become specialized animal companions.

Heightened Instincts.name: Instintos intensificados
Heightened Instincts.description: Has worked to sharpen tu companions' instincts to supernatural levels. When one of tu companions rolls a success on a tirada de salvación, it gets a critical success instead.

Indomitable Animal Companion.name: Indomitable Animal Companion
Indomitable Animal Companion.description: An indomitable companion increases its Constitution modifier by 2 and its Strength, Dexterity, and Wisdom modifiers by 1. It deals 3 daño adicional with its ataques sin armas. Increase its proficiency rank in Athletics to experto and its proficiency rank in barding to experto. It also learns the advanced maneuver for its type. If tu companion is Medium or smaller, it grows in size by one category. Its attacks count as magical for the purpose of ignoring resistances.

Mature Animal Companion.name: Mature Animal Companion
Mature Animal Companion.description:
When tú advance a young animal companion to a mature animal companion:

  • If tu companion is Medium or smaller, it grows by one size.
  • Increase its Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, and Wisdom modifiers by 1.
  • Increase its proficiency rank for Perception and all tiradas de salvación to experto. Increase its proficiency ranks in Intimidation, Stealth, and Survival to entrenado, and if it was already entrenado in one of those skills from its type, increase its proficiency rank in that skill to experto.
  • Increase its ataque sin armas daño from one die to two dice (for instance 1d8 to 2d8)

Nature's Precision.name: Precisión de la naturaleza
Nature's Precision.description: Tu companions pick at an enemigo's weak points. When tu companion strikes a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} criatura with an agile or finesse ataque sin armas, it deals an additional 1d4 daño de precisión (2d4 if the animal companion is specialized). If the companion already deals daño de precisión, combine the daño de precisión.

Nimble Animal Companion.name: Nimble Animal Companion
Nimble Animal Companion.description:
To advance a mature animal companion to a nimble animal companion:

  • Increase its Dexterity modifier by 2 and its Strength, Constitution, and Wisdom modifiers by 1.
  • Increase its proficiency ranks in Acrobatics to experto.
  • It deals 2 daño adicional with its ataques sin armas. Its attacks become magical for the purpose of ignoring resistances.
  • It learns the advanced maneuver for its type.

Peerless Mascot.name: Peerless Mascot
Peerless Mascot.description:
A commander's companion with the peerless mascot specialization gains the following benefits.

  • It gains a 30-pies aura that grants the same benefits as tu banner, effectively acting as a second banner. If tienes tu actual banner affixed to tu companion, the aura is a single 60-pies aura (this includes the increased aura benefit from Battle-Tested Companion). If tú later gain the Glorious Banner feat, tu banner has a 100-pies aura while it is affixed to tu peerless mascot companion.
  • It gains the beast rasgo.
  • Its Intelligence modifier increases by 2 and its Wisdom modifier increases by 1.
  • It is an experto in Warfare Lore.
  • It can speak one language that tú also speak (chosen at the time obtienes this feat).
  • Its maximum Puntos de Golpe increase by 20, increasing to 25 at 18th level, and 30 at 20th level.

  • Its mastery of all kinds of battlefields grants it a climb Velocidad and swim Velocidad equal to its land Velocidad; if it already had a Velocidad that was greater than its land Velocidad, then it has a climb Velocidad, swim Velocidad, and land Velocidad that are all equal to the highest Velocidad it has.

Racer.name: Racer
Racer.description: Tu companion races. It gains a +10-pies bonificador de estado to its Velocidad, swim Velocidad, or fly Velocidad (tu choice). Its proficiency in Fortitude saves increases to legendario, and its Constitution modifier increases by 1.

Running Kick.name: Patada a la carrera
Running Kick.description: Este companion Strides up to twice its Velocidad and makes a hoof, pies, or talon Golpe at any point during the movement. Este movement doesn't provoke reactions from a criatura damaged by the Golpe.

Savage Animal Companion.name: Savage Animal Companion
Savage Animal Companion.description: To advance a mature animal companion to a savage animal companion, increase its Strength modifier by 2 and its Dexterity, Constitution, and Wisdom modifiers by 1. It deals 3 daño adicional with its ataques sin armas. Increase its proficiency rank in Athletics to experto. It also learns the advanced maneuver for its type. If tu companion is Medium or smaller, it grows by one size. Its attacks become magical for the purpose of ignoring resistances.

Shade.name: Shade
Shade.description:
Acceso Shadowcaster

Tu companion's physical form is made, in whole or in part, of shadow. It gains darkvision, resistance 5 to all daño except force, and in areas of dim light or darkness, it can Dar un paso 10 pies instead of 5 pies. Its proficiency rank in unarmored defense increases to experto, or maestro if it's nimble.

Sinking Jaws.name: Mandíbulas hundidas
Sinking Jaws.description:
Requisitos Este companion has a criatura grabbed or restrained with its jaws or fangs

Efecto Este companion's grabbed or restrained foe takes daño perforante equal to the companion's level plus Strength modifier (@Damage[(@actor.level + @actor.abilities.str.mod)[piercing]])

Specialized Animal Companion.name: Specialized Animal Companion
Specialized Animal Companion.description:
Specialized animal companions are more intelligent and engage in more complex behaviors. Most animal companions can have only one specialization. The first time an animal gains a specialization, it also gains the following.

  • Its proficiency rank for ataques sin armas increases to experto.
  • Its proficiency ranks for tiradas de salvación and Perception increase to maestro.
  • Increase its Dexterity modifier by 1 and its Intelligence modifier by 2.
  • Its ataque sin armas daño increases from two dice to three dice, and it increases its daño adicional with ataques sin armas from 2 to 4 or from 3 to 6.

Steadfast Strider.name: Steadfast Strider
Steadfast Strider.description: Tu companion ignores natural difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain from sediment or stone and can move across quicksand, mud, and similar surfaces as if they were solid. It gains a +2 bonificador de estado to tiradas de salvación and DCs to prevent being Shoved or Tripped. Its Strength modifier increases by 1 and its proficiency for barding increases to experto. Este specialization can only be selected by shaitan-touched companions.

Sweeping Tail.name: Barrido de cola
Sweeping Tail.description: Este companion makes two tail Golpes against different criaturas within its reach, increasing its multiple attack penalización as normal. On a hit, it pushes a target back 5 pies or 10 pies on a impacto crítico. Este is forced movement.

Tracker.name: Tracker
Tracker.description: Tu companion is an incredible tracker. It can move at full Velocidad while following tracks. Its proficiency rank in Survival increases to experto (or maestro if it was already an experto from its type), and its Wisdom modifier increases by 1.

Unseen Animal Companion.name: Unseen Animal Companion
Unseen Animal Companion.description: Cryptid animal companions look a touch peculiar, often with uncanny features or ones that seem to come from a different animal. If sufres a feat that would normally allow tú to elige to have tu companion become a savage or nimble animal companion, puedes elige to make it an unseen animal companion instead. An unseen companion increases its Wisdom modifier by 2 and its Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution modifiers by 1. It deals 3 daño adicional with its ataques sin armas and deals an extra 1d4 daño de precisión against flat‑footed targets (if the animal companion already deals daño de precisión, such as a cat, combine the daño de precisión). Increase its proficiency rank in Stealth to experto. It also learns the advanced maneuver for its type.

Vicious Rend.name: Desgarro cruel
Vicious Rend.description: Make two claw, fist, pincer, or talon Golpes against the same target, applying the multiple attack penalización as normal. If both Golpes hit, el objetivo takes an additional @Damage[1d6[bleed]] daño. Este daño increases to 2d6 if tu companion is specialized.

Wildfire Scorcher.name: Wildfire Scorcher
Wildfire Scorcher.description: Tu companion gains resistance to fire equal to tu level. Any criatura that attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} or Grab tu companion, hits tu companion with a melee ataque sin armas, or hits tu companion with a melee arma Golpe while adjacent to tu companion takes @Damage[2d6[fire]] daño. Its Dexterity modifier increases by 1 and its proficiency rank increases to legendario for Reflex saves and to experto for unarmored defense. Este specialization can only be selected by efreeti-touched companions.

Wind Chaser.name: Wind Chaser
Wind Chaser.description: Tu companion gains a +20-pies bonificador de estado to its Velocidad or fly Velocidad (tu choice if it has both). Its proficiency in Acrobatics increases to maestro and its Dexterity modifier increases by 1. Its proficiency rank increases to legendario for Reflex saves and to experto for unarmored defense. Este specialization can only be selected by djinni-touched companions.

0.prompt: Which speed should gain a bonus?

Wrecker.name: Destructor
Wrecker.description: Tu companion smashes things. Its ataques sin armas ignore half an object's Hardness. Its Athletics proficiency increases to maestro, and its Strength modifier increases by 1.
